description: Land Title Settlement Department - Liyangolla, Siyambalanduwa D/S Division, Monaragala District - Cad. Map No. 720009
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and title classifications. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property registration, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
